en_title: Avengers: Endgame Encore Collects $86 Million in Theaters as New Scenes Help MCU Fans Prep for Doomsday
cn_title: 《复联4》重映首周末收8600万美元(约合人民币6亿元)
subtitle: 新片段带观众重返影院
opus_summary: 《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》重映版首周末全球票房预估达8600万美元(约合人民币6亿元)，登顶全球票房榜。新增片段直接关联今年12月的《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》，推动影迷重返影院。

paragraphs.en: Avengers: Endgame Encore dusted off an estimated $86 million at the box office as new scenes helped bring Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) fans back to theaters to prep for Doomsday.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》重映版预估收获8600万美元(约合人民币6亿元)票房。新增片段吸引漫威电影宇宙影迷重返影院，为《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》做准备。

paragraphs.en: It's a gargantuan opening weekend for Disney and Marvel's Infinity Saga-ending re-release that saw it rank atop global charts. Of its $86 million debut, it earned $26 million domestically and $60 million internationally.
paragraphs.cn: 这部为迪士尼和漫威「无限传奇」画上句号的电影，重映首周末票房表现强劲，登顶全球票房榜。预估8600万美元(约合人民币6亿元)票房中，北美市场贡献2600万美元(约合人民币2亿元)，其他市场贡献6000万美元(约合人民币4亿元)。

paragraphs.en: For those unaware of why Avengers: Endgame is back in theaters, there are a few reasons audiences have shown up in droves to watch the seven-year-old MCU movie. First and foremost, the Encore re-release comes with a few minutes of extra footage that ties directly into this December's superhero crossover event film, Avengers: Doomsday . With director Joe Russo previously setting up the new clips as "critical" to the next movie's plot , it seemed inevitable that at least die-hard fans would show up.
paragraphs.cn: 这部上映已有七年的漫威电影为何重返影院，又为何吸引大批观众？原因有几个，其中最重要的是重映版新增了几分钟片段，直接关联今年12月上映的超级英雄联动电影《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》。导演Joe Russo此前称，这些新片段对下一部电影的剧情「至关重要」，因此至少会有铁杆影迷前来观影，似乎并不意外。

paragraphs.en: There's been plenty of debate about whether those new precious minutes of MCU footage could justify the price of another ticket , but with another $86 million in the bank, it seems there were plenty who thought it was enough. It helped that, outside of one scene , most of Avengers: Endgame Encore keeps the original story intact, giving moviegoers a chance to relive all of the hype moments and big reveals before Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, and more return to the MCU later this year.
paragraphs.cn: 为了这几分钟珍贵的漫威新片段再买一张电影票，究竟值不值？这个问题引发了不少争论。但从重映版预估再收8600万美元(约合人民币6亿元)来看，似乎有很多人觉得值。除了一场戏，重映版基本保留了原有剧情，也让观众有机会在小罗伯特·唐尼、克里斯·埃文斯、克里斯·海姆斯沃斯等人今年晚些时候回归漫威电影宇宙前，重温片中那些激动人心的时刻和重大揭秘。

paragraphs.en: As Avengers: Endgame Encore brings the end of Thanos' mission to conquer the universe with the Infinity Stones back to theaters, it also sees the return of one of the biggest theatrical releases of all time. The Avengers movie shattered records upon its release in 2019 and eventually returned later that same year for its first re-release . Many of its notable feats have held up in the seven years since, with only Tom Holland's Spider-Man: Brand New Day able to topple some of them last month.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》重映版让观众再次在影院看到灭霸利用无限宝石征服宇宙的计划如何落幕，也让影史票房最高的电影之一重返大银幕。这部《复仇者联盟》电影2019年上映时打破多项纪录，并于当年晚些时候首次重映。七年过去，它创下的许多亮眼纪录仍未被打破，只有汤姆·赫兰德主演的《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》在上个月刷新了其中几项。

paragraphs.en: Through it all, Avengers: Endgame has now soared to an unbelievable $2.885 billion worldwide total. Disney has marked it as the second-highest debut for a re-release ever, falling only behind 2012's Titanic 3D.
paragraphs.cn: 算上此次重映，《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》的全球累计票房现已达到惊人的28.85亿美元(约合人民币194亿元)。迪士尼称，此次重映的首周末票房位居影史第二，仅次于2012年重映的《泰坦尼克号》3D版。

paragraphs.en: While Marvel and Disney take what feels like an endless run of victory laps, Zach Cregger's Resident Evil proved it has some staying power after its second weekend in theaters. It brought in another $23 million domestically and $27 million internationally, with its two-weekend total sitting at $196.5 million on a reported $75 million budget. Despite facing an uphill battle with some fans , the Capcom video game-turned-horror-movie quickly became the highest-rated game adaptation of all time .
paragraphs.cn: 漫威和迪士尼似乎还在不断庆祝胜利，Zach Cregger执导的《生化危机》则在上映第二个周末证明了自己的票房后劲。影片在北美市场再收2300万美元(约合人民币2亿元)，其他市场再收2700万美元(约合人民币2亿元)，两个周末的累计票房达到1.965亿美元(约合人民币13亿元)，据报道制作预算为7500万美元(约合人民币5亿元)。尽管这部根据卡普空游戏改编的恐怖片在部分粉丝那里面临阻力，它仍迅速成为有史以来评分最高的游戏改编作品。

paragraphs.en: Also opening at the box office this weekend was the Brad Pitt-led and doggy-driven survival flick, Heart of the Beast , which brought $50.1 million globally and fetched an 8/10 review from IGN. Director Lance Oppenheim and star Robert Pattinson's Primetime , a big biopic based on Chris Hansen's To Catch a Predator that IGN awarded a 9/10 , earned $19.2 million domestically.
paragraphs.cn: 本周末上映的还有布拉德·皮特主演、以狗为重要角色的生存题材电影《Heart of the Beast》。该片全球票房达到5010万美元(约合人民币3亿元)，IGN给出8分。由Lance Oppenheim执导、罗伯特·帕丁森主演的传记电影《Primetime》取材于Chris Hansen的节目《To Catch a Predator》，IGN给出9分；影片北美票房为1920万美元(约合人民币1亿元)。

paragraphs.en: Avengers: Endgame Encore is mostly the same movie we saw in 2019, but that doesn't mean it hasn't spawned plenty to talk about as Doomsday approaches. One topic on fans' minds involves a new star-studded, pre-movie opener that asks fans to silence their phones .
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》重映版与观众2019年看到的电影基本相同，但随着《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》临近，它依然引出了不少讨论。其中一个话题是新增的映前短片：多位明星在片中提醒观众将手机调至静音。
